title: Needs and wants
log: 2026-11-12T12:44:14Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new
2026-11-12T15:15:32Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: The bank point ecb-business teaches what a business is, with needs and wants only as a side definition, and it is pitched for Year 7 in other states, so it does not teach the Victorian Level 7 and 8 idea that needs and wants are the basis of scarcity and choice.

draft.title: Needs and wants
card: Things people must have to survive, such as food, water, clothing and shelter.
Things people would like to have but can live without, such as a games console or a holiday.
To sort an item, ask: could the person survive without it? If yes, it is a want. If no, it is a need.
The same type of item can be either. A warm coat in a cold winter is a need. A fifth coat in a new style is a want.
draft.remember: A need is required to survive. A want is something you would like but can live without.

a.q: Which of these is a want rather than a need?
opts: A new pair of designer sunglasses
A bottle of clean drinking water
A roof to sleep under at night
a.why: A person can live without designer sunglasses, so they are a want. Water, shelter and food are required to survive, so they are needs.
a.clue: Which one could a person live without?

b.q: Leila lives in Ballarat, where winters are cold. She buys a basic warm jacket, then also buys a fourth jacket because it is in fashion. Which describes her purchases?
opts: The first jacket is a need, the fourth is a want
Both jackets are needs, as jackets are clothing
Both jackets are wants, as she could stay inside
The first jacket is a want, the fourth is a need
b.why: A basic warm jacket helps her stay safe in the cold, so it is a need. A fourth jacket bought for fashion is something she can live without, so it is a want. The type of item, clothing, does not decide this on its own.
b.clue: Ask whether she could survive without each jacket.

a.best: A new pair of designer sunglasses

b.best: The first jacket is a need, the fourth is a want
